name: Plinth
description: A Plotform adaptation for an art space: an oversized wordmark, an offset twelve column grid, exhibition entries as typographic blocks with dates and rooms, flat colour fields and a floor plan drawn in SVG. No photography anywhere.
designNotes: Plotform adaptation of AstroPaper's type first architecture and dated entry list, not an unchanged upstream template.
Abstract identity: five marks and a floor plan written as SVG by hand, flat colour fields and CSS diagonal rules. No photographs and no generated images.
Working programme filter (on now, upcoming, past), a list or grid view switch, and a native mobile navigation dialog across five pages.
